tv_wonder_new_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {

		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 20
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_mountain_terrace_network }
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 21

tv_wonder_new_ceremony_ready_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	var:tv_wonder_locked ?= { this >= 19 }
	var:tv_wonder_locked ?= { this <= 39 }
}
